The '''Tasari Crossbow''' was a traditional weapon among [[Tasari]] warriors, and a particular favorite of blood cultists. Each weapon was individually manufactured as dictated by tradition, and they were never mass-produced. The construction of a crossbow was a significant event in a Tasari's life, and marked the passage from childhood to becoming an adult.<ref name="J15" />
